messages:
Tara: Heads-up — Datadog requested a press preview of our new telemetry tile in the GCP marketplace next Tue 10am PT. Need a quick checklist: dashboard screenshots, OTLP sample, embed flow demo creds, SSO link, embargo date. Who can own each item?

Sam: I can own OTLP sample + redaction. Will post a curl example and a tiny trace payload by EOD.

Leo: SI playbook owner here — I need an on-prem collector recipe (airgap notes) and a one-page install checklist for partners. Can do a draft tomorrow.

Michelle: Marketing — we'll need 16:9 screenshot(s), a short 60s demo script, and a one-pager for press. If engineering can hand assets by Thu, design can turn around by Fri.

Nora: Legal — asking about embargo and customer logos. We also need a short privacy blurb about telemetry samples (no raw IPs/PII). Proposed embargo window?

Tara: Proposed embargo: Tue 2026-02-18 17:00 PT. @Nora does that work? Also, Datadog wants a staging demo URL and a demo account with limited scopes.

Nora: That embargo works. Make sure telemetry sample removes identifiers — Sam, please confirm sample is scrubbed.

Sam: Confirmed. I'll redact IPs/ids. Example quicktest (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://telemetry-staging.redwood/api/v1/otlp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"resource":{},"spans":[{"name":"inference","attributes":{"model":"redwood-llm","lat_ms":120}}]}'
```

Leo: For the SI notes I'll include: collector config snippet, port mappings, firewall reqs, and an airgapped install option (tarball + offline docs). Will link repo: https://github.com/redwood/si-telemetry-playbook (draft).

Michelle: Marketing added Jen as PR contact (jen@redwood.com). Also need a hero screenshot with traces + latency heatmap. Can you produce a high-res image, Sam?

Sam: Yep. I'll export a sanitized screenshot and the raw JSON example to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/obs/telemetry-press (access: demo-account).

deploy-bot: Preview deploy to staging succeeded for telemetry-tile v2 (build 523) — https://staging.redwood.com/telemetry-tile (checks: smoke OK). :white_check_mark:

Tara: Great. Action items so far: Sam = OTLP sample + screenshot; Leo = SI playbook + airgap recipe; Michelle = PR assets + script; Nora = embargo/legal signoff. I'll create a short checklist doc and assign owners.

Leo: I'll run a partner dry-run with Datadog next Mon 9am PT to test SSO and demo flows.

Sam: Sharing OTLP quickstart link for the thread: https://docs.redwood.com/otel-quickstart — will tailor a snippet for the press preview.

Michelle: Can someone add a brief demo script bullets here? I can flesh into a script.

Tara: Draft bullets: 1) 15s product intro; 2) show marketplace tile + click to embed; 3) open dashboard, highlight latency heatmap; 4) show trace drilldown and noisy span; 5) explain routing/fallback briefly; 6) Q&A.

Michelle: Perfect, will expand.

Nora: Once assets are ready, send to legal review. Also confirm no customer data in screenshots.

Tara: Will do. I'll sync with Alex (Datadog) to confirm time and access. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
